steps.name: install the pinned dependencies (needs network)
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import subprocess, sys, pathlib; exe = pathlib.Path('.venv') / ('Scripts' if sys.platform == 'win32' else 'bin') / 'python'; sys.exit(subprocess.call([str(exe), '-m', 'pip', 'install', '-r', 'requirements.txt']))"

steps.name: offline demo: span, correlated log, counter
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import subprocess, sys, pathlib; exe = pathlib.Path('.venv') / ('Scripts' if sys.platform == 'win32' else 'bin') / 'python'; sys.exit(subprocess.call([str(exe), 'demo.py']))"
steps.expect_stdout:
span names: ['complete_task']
span attributes: {'task.id': 1}
log carries the span's trace id: True
log message and field: task completed 1
counter app.tasks.completed: 1

steps.name: tests
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import subprocess, sys, pathlib; exe = pathlib.Path('.venv') / ('Scripts' if sys.platform == 'win32' else 'bin') / 'python'; sys.exit(subprocess.call([str(exe), '-m', 'unittest']))"
